2923075720.claim: Historical high price momentum from 20 to 10 periods ago, measured as the rate of change of the HIGH price, is a positive value.
2923075720.verification_plan: Calculate the 10-period rate of change of the HIGH price, lagged by 10 periods. Perform a one-sample t-test against the null hypothesis that the mean ROC is zero. Report the mean ROC and its statistical significance (p-value).

1004061202.claim: The acceleration in the option premium index, measured as the second derivative of PREMIUM_INDEX_CLOSE, is a positive value.
1004061202.verification_plan: Calculate the first difference of PREMIUM_INDEX_CLOSE, then calculate the first difference of that series to obtain the acceleration. Perform a one-sample t-test against the null hypothesis that the mean acceleration is zero. Report the mean acceleration and its statistical significance (p-value).

193904552.claim: The historical high price momentum (from 20 to 10 periods ago) exceeds the contemporaneous acceleration in the option premium index.
193904552.condition: roc(HIGH, window=10, shift=10) > roc(roc(PREMIUM_INDEX_CLOSE, window=1), window=1)
193904552.verification_plan: Calculate the two series as defined in previous claims. Perform a paired t-test to determine if the mean difference (momentum minus acceleration) is significantly greater than zero. Report the mean difference and its p-value.

614764312.claim: A new high in the normalized 20-period moving average of OPEN prices occurs, defined as the current value exceeding all previous values in a rolling window.
614764312.verification_plan: Calculate the 20-period simple moving average (SMA) of OPEN. For each period, check if the SMA value is greater than the maximum SMA value from the previous 20 periods. Calculate the proportion of periods where this condition is true and compare it to the expected proportion under a random walk null model using a binomial test.

1647461125.claim: The condition where historical high price momentum exceeds premium index acceleration coincides with a higher probability of observing a new high in the normalized OPEN moving average, compared to when the condition is not met.
1647461125.condition: P(new_high | momentum > acceleration) > P(new_high | momentum <= acceleration)
1647461125.verification_plan: Define the binary condition (momentum > acceleration) and the binary event (new high in normalized OPEN SMA). Create a 2x2 contingency table. Perform a chi-squared test of independence. Calculate and report the odds ratio and its confidence interval to quantify the strength of the association.
